estimates.title: Estimates
estimates.label: Let Orchester estimate story points
estimates.hint: For tasks that have none, with a reason · uses the reviewer’s model and counts toward the daily budget
estimates.info: Orchester sizes each new task, and a task whose brief or criteria change, in story points (1, 2, 3, 5, 8, 13 or 21) with a short reason, from the brief, the criteria and the project's merged tasks. Each estimate asks the reviewer’s model under Approvals and spends tokens, which count toward the project's daily budget. Points you set are never changed. Only you can change this, here in the window.
estimates.decisionHint: For tasks that have none · on {{connection}}, as the reviewer writes no reasons
estimates.decisionInfo: Estimates use {{connection}} · {{model}}, the project's default language reviewer, because a decision model writes no reasons. Each estimate spends tokens that count toward the daily budget. Points you set are never changed. Only you can change this setting, here in the window.

orchestrator.onlyYou: Only you, here in the window
orchestrator.foot: Off: the Orchestrator proposes it in the chat and you apply it. Each project has its own; a new project starts with all off.
orchestrator.blocked: A change brought by automation was not taken: only you change this setting, here in the window.

publishDrafts.label: Publish drafts
publishDrafts.hint: Pipelines, profiles, instructions, skills and tools it drafts
publishDrafts.info: Lets the Orchestrator's chat publish the pipelines, agent profiles, instructions, skills and tools it drafts in this project, without your click. Off: it proposes each publish as a card you apply. A draft that widens what agents may do still needs Let automation change agent permissions. Only you can change this, here in the window.
publishDrafts.on: The chat publishes without asking in this project and keeps each publish as an action in its conversation. A draft that widens what agents may do is still proposed while Let automation change agent permissions is off.

answerAgents.label: Answer agents
answerAgents.hint: Read their questions and answer, or tell you with a recommendation
answerAgents.info: Lets the Orchestrator's chat answer agents' questions and send messages to a run's agents in this project without your click, and start a turn by itself when an agent asks or waits for a message. Off: it proposes each answer as a card you apply, and tells you when an agent waits. Approvals and plan decisions stay yours. Only you can change this, here in the window.

mergeRuns.label: Merge runs
mergeRuns.hint: When you ask it in the chat
mergeRuns.info: Lets the Orchestrator's chat merge a run you asked it to merge, without your click: only a task's latest run that succeeded, and only when the main checkout needs no local integration. Off: it proposes each merge as a card you apply. Conflicts and approving a merged result stay yours, on the Local integration page. Only you can change this, here in the window.

mergeFinished.label: Merge finished runs on its own
mergeFinished.hint: Without asking, when every step passed · needs Merge runs and Answer agents
mergeFinished.info: When a task's run succeeds, the Orchestrator's chat merges it without your click: only the task's latest run whose every step passed (a step you accepted as it was counts, one automation accepted does not), never a task marked Blocked or blocked by unfinished tasks, while new starts are held, or for a task that says Don't merge automatically, and only when the main checkout needs no local integration. It tries each run once, one at a time in the order they finished; conflicts it proposes to send back to an agent, anything else it leaves to you. Needs Merge runs and Answer agents on too. Off: it tells you a run is ready and the merge stays yours. Only you can change this, here in the window.

continueInterrupted.label: Continue interrupted runs
continueInterrupted.info: Lets the Orchestrator's chat continue a run that a crash, the runner going away or quitting the app interrupted, from its last checkpoint, without your Continue. With Answer agents also on, it continues such a run once when it is interrupted, but leaves one interrupted again within 10 minutes to you. Off: continuing stays yours, on the task's Summary. Runs stopped at a limit, runs you canceled and runs whose worktree is gone stay yours. Only you can change this, here in the window.

writeGit.label: Write with git
writeGit.hint: Commit, branch, pull and push when you ask it to
writeGit.info: Lets the Orchestrator's chat commit, create and switch branches, pull, push, merge, revert, tag and fetch in the project's repository when you ask it to. None of these loses work: a switch keeps your changes or is refused, a pull only fast-forwards unless you ask for a merge, a push never forces, and a conflict is undone. Reset, clean, deleting a branch or tag, a forced push, discarding changes and rebase stay cards you apply, whatever this says. Never in a run's worktree before the run ended. Off: the chat only reads git. Only you can change this, here in the window.
